findings.title: companies shallow-fingerprint delta observed between first probe and post-suite-1 window — environmental, not reproducible, not caused by ZR-1004
findings.detail: During review, the companies/ shallow fingerprint read 7dfb1ca2... in the first independent probe but c2e55234... afterwards, and it has been stable since. Attribution: the delta fell inside the window where full suite run #1 executed concurrently with the zr806 regression subset, ruff, ratchet, and with Dropbox/OneDrive sync daemons starting (10:44-10:47). Exculpatory evidence: (1) suite run #2 (identical command, run without concurrency) produced ZERO diffs on companies children before/after; (2) isolated test_zr1004 run: companies before==after (c2e55234); (3) independent probe re-run: before==after, all checks pass; (4) the suite's own C2 zero-write oracle (test_c2_journeys_leave_roots_and_catalog_untouched) passed in both full-suite runs; (5) no child under companies has a suite-window mtime and git shows no changes there; (6) dayu/dropbox/future_lake fingerprints and catalog row counts (23530/43112/46606) were identical across every snapshot. The ZR-1004 test file contains no write operations (resolve + fingerprints + sqlite mode=ro only), so this is an environmental observation, not a defect.
